story_text:
## See Clearly. Stay in Your Flow.
As the years go by, fine details up close become harder to see. Whether you’re reading, working, or creating, you want to see every detail clearly and look up into the distance with ease, without constantly pausing to adjust.
VIVIFoCAL S1 uses adaptive focus technology to adjust lens power as your viewing distance changes. From fine details up close to the bigger picture in the distance, your focus shifts naturally and you stay immersed in what you’re doing.
## One Pair. More Ways to See Clearly.
Whether you’re focused on work, making something by hand, or simply enjoying everyday life, there’s no more switching glasses or shifting your posture just to see clearly. S1 adapts as your viewing distance changes, so you see clearly and move with ease through work, creative projects, and everyday life.
## Built for Real Life
Glasses designed for everyday life should do more than help you see clearly. They should stay comfortable for hours, support your prescription, and simply work. From its lightweight design and prescription support to its adaptive focus performance and the technology behind it, S1 is built around everyday use. Here’s what that looks like in practice.
## Adaptive Focus That Moves With You
Traditional glasses can’t adjust lens power to your viewing distance. When switching between near and far, you often have to take them off, swap pairs, or shift your posture to see clearly.
From fine details up close to distant views, S1 adapts naturally to every viewing distance. No more taking glasses off, switching pairs, or tilting your head to find the clear spot. You stay focused on your work and your day.
S1 senses your viewing distance with an infrared distance sensor and automatically adjusts lens power to match. The result is fewer visual interruptions, a natural posture as your focus shifts, and attention that stays on what you’re doing.
## From Detail to Distance. Always Clear.
From reading small print up close to taking in distant scenery, one pair of glasses handles it all, with no need to adjust your viewing distance or posture.
S1 supports viewing distances from 8 inches (20 cm) to infinity, keeping both nearby details and distant views clear. It adapts easily to the shifting visual demands of work and everyday life.
## Full Lens Clarity. More Natural Vision.
Traditional progressive lenses offer only a small clear zone, so you tilt your head or shift your gaze to find the right spot. S1 takes a different approach. Its adaptive focus technology adjusts lens power based on viewing distance, delivering clarity across the entire lens without the need to search for a specific clear zone.
With a field of view (FoV) of over 110°, the whole lens adapts to your viewing distance, delivering a wider, more natural view with none of the usual peripheral distortion.
## Clear Vision. Uninterrupted Workflow.
Switching between near and far shouldn’t mean pausing to refocus, repositioning your head, or waiting for vision to sharpen. With multi-sensor detection and AI-assisted focus control, S1 adjusts focus in less than 0.1 seconds, responding the moment your viewing distance changes. Near-to-far transitions feel natural with less lag, so work, creative projects, and everyday moments keep flowing.
## Focus Lock at Your Fingertips
When you want a fixed focus, simply press the button on the temple to lock the current lens power. The lenses stop adjusting to changes in viewing distance until you release the lock, so you decide when S1 adapts and when it holds still.
## All Day Comfort Wear
S1 comes with three sizes of interchangeable nose pads and flexible, ergonomically designed temples to suit different face shapes and fit preferences. It stays secure and comfortable without tightness or pressure, so you can stay focused without interruption.
S1 manages power intelligently for how you actually use it, delivering over 8 hours of real-time adaptive focus even with frequent adjustments (thousands of focus cycles). With lighter everyday use, the battery can last all day. A full charge takes about 1 hour, so S1 is ready for tomorrow.
## Customize Your Experience
S1 offers custom lens options, allowing for greater flexibility in lens configuration and a more personalized everyday experience. Whatever your vision needs, S1 supports clear vision at both near and far distances.
Custom lens options are built into the fixed inner lens, working alongside S1’s adaptive focus system without adding another layer of lenses.
Your eyes change over time, and so do your visual needs. Adjust your lens power directly through the VIVIFoCAL app. Make small adjustments to suit your needs.
## Magnetic Clip-On Sunglasses
The magnetic sunglass clip-on snaps directly onto the front of your glasses, so you can switch to sunglasses if needed. Whether you’re going for a walk, or traveling, one quick snap adapts S1 to outdoor light without changing your entire pair of glasses.
Bright sunlight and light reflecting off flat surfaces like roads and water create glare that strains your eyes outdoors. S1’s magnetic sunglass clip-on features polarized lenses that cut glare and provide 100% UV protection, shielding your eyes from harmful ultraviolet rays for a more comfortable view outdoors.
## As Seen In
Explore media coverage and independent perspectives on VIVIFoCAL S1, its adaptive-focus technology, and the future of everyday eyewear.
## What the Pros Are Saying
@vrgamerdude reviews the S1, highlighting its mechanical lens-shifting technology and its potential for switching between different tasks at a desk, offering his perspective on the adaptive eyewear in everyday use.
From desk work to detail repairs, @TECHNO TESTED puts S1 through his daily routine, sharing how its adaptive focus compares with his usual glasses and when Focus Lock and app adjustments come in handy.
@Tech Talk With Jeremy puts S1 through real-world focus tests, switching between reading, computer work, and distant views. He highlights its fast lens response, mid-distance clarity, and Focus Lock feature, sharing how adaptive focus can simplify everyday tasks without constantly changing glasses.
## Hear From Our Early Adopters
As both a modeler and an optometrist, @Interstellar Modeler puts S1 to the test through model-making and everyday computer work. From handling tiny details to moving between screens, he demonstrates how S1 adapts to different viewing distances and how Focus Lock helps maintain steady focus during close-up tasks.
@Jason Eaton puts S1 to the test across different viewing distances—from detailed model work to his computer screen and surroundings. He shares how S1 compares with his regular glasses in clarity, comfort, and everyday use.
## A Look Back at Our Exhibition
Take a look at VIVIFoCAL S1 at Wonder Festival, where we connected with model-making enthusiasts and introduced our adaptive-focus technology to visitors.

If you have any questions or concerns about your order after the campaign ends, please feel free to contact our support team at support@vivifocal.c…

faq.q: What is the warranty period for the VIVIFoCAL S1 unit?
faq.a:
VIVIFoCAL S1 comes with a 1-year warranty from the date of delivery, covering defects in materials, workmanship, and electronic components under normal use.
Customers in the European Union are also entitled to the applicable 2-year statutory legal guarantee in accordance with local consumer protection regulations.
The warranty covers defects affecting the optical, structural, or electronic functions of the eyewear.

faq.q: What is the expected shipping time?
faq.a:
VIVIFoCAL S1 is expected to begin shipping in January 2027, following the conclusion of the Kickstarter campaign. Once your order is dispatched, you will receive a tracking number to follow its delivery progress.
Please note that actual delivery times may vary depending on your destination and local logistics conditions.

faq.q: What is the customs fee policy for VIVIFoCAL S1 and all add-ons?
faq.a: VIVIFoCAL covers applicable customs duties for VIVIFoCAL S1 and all add-ons shipped to our supported regions. A flat shipping fee of US$10 applies to available shipping regions.

faq.q: How can I get in contact with you?
faq.a: Please email us at support@vivifocal.com or send the message through the Kickstarter inbox. Our customer service team will be happy to assist you and reply as soon as possible.
